title: Islam: Overview — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Islam teaches submission to one God, called Allah, revealed through the Prophet Muhammad, and it is the world's second-largest religion. The Pew Research Center estimated about 1.6 billion Muslims in 2010, about 23 percent of the world population. This overview edition presents Islam: Overview within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Islam teaches submission to one God, called Allah, revealed through the Prophet Muhammad, and it is the world's second-largest religion. The Pew Research Center estimated about 1.6 billion Muslims in 2010, about 23 percent of the world population.
sacred_texts: Hadith collections, including Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim
spec.adherents: About 1.6 billion in 2010, per Pew, projected near 1.8 billion by 2015.

example.fact: Large Muslim populations live across the Middle East, North Africa, South Asia, and Southeast Asia.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
